description: The detector misses a ground-truth focus-order failure involving entry into or exit from the browser context because the original detection approach only evaluates webpage-element transitions.
matching_criteria: A transition with Browser as its source or destination.

description: The detector overlooks problematic ordering between functionally related form controls such as text inputs, password fields, checkboxes, recovery links, and submit buttons.
matching_criteria: A transition between controls belonging to the same form or user workflow.

description: The detector overlooks a focus-order failure involving movement between distinct webpage regions such as headers, main content, navigation sections, or footers.
matching_criteria: A transition connecting elements in different identifiable webpage regions.

description: The ground truth identifies a failure even though the visible arrangement or available descriptions do not clearly establish the underlying focus-order problem.
matching_criteria: A ground-truth LNF with apparently related or locally aligned elements and insufficient evidence for a more specific explanation.

description: The detector misses a failure involving elements whose relationships depend on interface state or navigation context not fully represented in the available data.
matching_criteria: A transition involving a documented state change or incomplete contextual relationship between elements.

description: The detector misses a failure involving the order of interactive media and related textual elements within the same visual component.
matching_criteria: A transition between related media and text controls inside one card or component.

description: The detector flags a transition based on an apparent visual or functional-order discrepancy even though the ground truth does not classify it as a failure.
matching_criteria: A predicted LNF whose explanation relies on a visual or functional-order discrepancy not judged to disrupt meaning or operability.

description: The detector may incorrectly flag a transition because the inferred meaningful order or element grouping does not reflect the actual webpage relationship.
matching_criteria: A predicted LNF with documented disagreement between Stage 1 interpretation and supporting webpage evidence.

pattern_name: Normal page or section transition overflagged
description: The detector identifies a normal transition between webpage sections as an LNF despite no corresponding ground-truth failure.
matching_criteria: A predicted LNF crossing identifiable webpage sections where evidence indicates the sequence preserves meaning and operability.

description: The detector flags a transition returning focus toward an earlier visual region even though the ground truth accepts that navigation behavior.
matching_criteria: A predicted LNF involving a return from later content to an earlier page region.

description: The detector flags a transition between nested or closely related interactive elements even though the ground truth does not identify a failure.
matching_criteria: A predicted LNF connecting controls within the same interactive component or nested structure.
